text: (A Gyria woman sits bound to a post. She watches you and says nothing.)
(A Gyria woman sits bound to a post by the tents.)
Come to gloat, human? Vorga tied me here. I told him the truth and he didn't like it.
We didn't come south to raid. Something is killing the north. The Pale Withering - it takes the colour out of everything, then the life.
...You're a strange warden. Here. My token - show it to any Gyria who'll listen.
Vorga waits north of the fires, by the stones. He hits hard and he hits everyone. Guard when he raises his axe.
Hah. Of course. Then do me one kindness - beat Vorga. He's north of the fires.
Maybe your Warden will listen better than he did.
Go. Vorga's north of the fires.
Still here. Still tied. Go do something useful, warden.
